profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
IT professional in a wide variety of business applications. Particularly interested .NET architecture, web applications and relational database design using SQL Server, and Oracle.

Specialties: .NET, C#, Software Architect, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Oracle, Technical Writing, UML, Obeject Oriented Programming, TFS, Sharepoint Server
BS-Engg, MS-CS, MCP, MCAD
MCTS:.NET Framework 2.0 Web Applications
MCTS: .NET Framework 2.0 Windows Applications
Agile Methodologies, AngularJS, Jasmine
Machine Leaening algorithms

positions.title: Software Apps Engineer III
positions.description:
Working on Front Office System using technologies like AngularJS, JQuery, Jasmine, Node.js, SQLFire, nServiceBus, Selenium. Working on creating one source of knowledge for vehicle inventory.

Practicing Scrum Agile development process.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed asp.net, windows apps using .net 3.5, 4.0, SQL server 2008.

positions.title: Software Dev Manager
positions.description: Designed and developed Service Contract System (Web Application to manage Extended Warranty business) using ASP.NET, C#, SQL Server, VS 2003/2005. Designed various architectures to solve business problems and meet performance expectation. Major contribution in conversion of ERP scale web application from VB6 to ASP.NET/C#.

positions.title: Software Dev Manager
positions.description: Conversion of Extended Warranty Management (SCS) to .net from vb6.
